import ctypes
import os

# Load the dynamic libraries
ctypes.CDLL('/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so', mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
gsl = ctypes.CDLL('/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so')

# Define the function prototype for gsl_ran_lognormal
gsl.gsl_ran_lognormal.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_double, ctypes.c_double]
gsl.gsl_ran_lognormal.restype = ctypes.c_double

# Define the function to call gsl_ran_lognormal
def generate_lognormal(rng, zeta, sigma):
    return gsl.gsl_ran_lognormal(rng, zeta, sigma)

# Test cases
def assert_test():
    # Initialize the GSL random number generator
    gsl_rng_alloc = gsl.gsl_rng_alloc
    gsl_rng_alloc.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p]
    gsl_rng_alloc.restype = ctypes.c_void_p
    rng_type = ctypes.c_void_p.in_dll(gsl, 'gsl_rng_default')
    rng = gsl_rng_alloc(rng_type)

    # Check if rng allocation was successful
    assert rng is not None, "Failed to allocate RNG"

    # Test with known parameters
    zeta = 0.0
    sigma = 1.0
    result = generate_lognormal(rng, zeta, sigma)
    assert isinstance(result, float), "Result should be a float"
    assert result > 0, "Log-normal random variable should be positive"

    # Test with different parameters
    zeta = 1.0
    sigma = 0.5
    result = generate_lognormal(rng, zeta, sigma)
    assert isinstance(result, float), "Result should be a float"
    assert result > 0, "Log-normal random variable should be positive"

    # Free the RNG
    gsl.gsl_rng_free(rng)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    assert_test()
